Creality has introduced the SPARKX i7 Nano, a desktop 3D printer that aims to democratize multi-color additive manufacturing by offering a compact, affordable solution priced at $299. This new model, which is part of the broader i7 series, distinguishes itself through its space-saving engineering.

results.title: Creality’s Pika Wants To Make 3D Scanning Feel As Easy As Taking A Photo
results.author: Brendan Frye
highlights:
3D scanning has long been a tedious endeavour, with even simpler options on the market feeling like they require users to learn a complex new skill. Creality is looking to change that with its new Pika portable 3D scanner.
...
Designed for portability, the Creality Pika resembles a standard point-and-shoot camera more than the complex equipment many users are accustomed to. It appears to be a major step forward for makers, creators and anyone interested in
...
printing or modelling.
...
The Pika launched July 22 for $699 USD, with a 10% introductory discount available for 20 days. It includes Wi-Fi 6 and USB 3.0 connectivity, along with two removable 3,350 mAh batteries.
